title: asked AI to make a trailer for my game and it did! 🤯🤯🤯
author: ilyxxxxa
selftext:
all in single prompt! (this took like 3 tries)  
  
first i gave screenshots of the game itself to nanobanana2 and asked it to generate screens in the plasticine style, then asked Claude to write a prompt for Seedance based on the images, then gave the 9 screens to Seedance 2.0 reference-to-video, and voila  
  
tbh this is absolutely crazy! i have not expected anything close to this.

replies.author: ilyxxxxa
replies.body:
Here is the full prompt: “15-second teaser trailer for a co-op video game called "UP! with a stranger". Stop-motion plasticine claymation, plasticine stop motion style. Visible fingerprint texture in clay. Hard cuts between shots, no smooth transitions. Every shot contains ONE dramatic explosive action — never floating or drifting, always a specific big motion with a clear before-and-after. The two blobs are NEVER perfectly synced — one always leads with the action, the other reacts and gets dragged along by the red plasticine rope between them. Playful, weird, emotional, with one big climax and a satisfying logo reveal.

The trailer's audio is a building electronic-cinematic track in the spirit of an indie game trailer — punchy lo-fi hip hop drum break layered with playful synth bleeps, cinematic whoosh risers between cuts, building from a quiet pulse at shot 1 to full beat drops by shot 4, peak at shot 7, slamming silent for the snap, resolving into a bouncy outro for the logo. NOT a calm piano trailer. Energetic, modern, fun.

Shot 1 (1.2s): @Image1 - Low-angle camera. The PURPLE blob suddenly LEAPS upward off the backyard ground, body stretching from the jump. The red rope between them goes instantly taut and YANKS the brown blob into the air after it, the brown blob's eyes bulging in surprise as it gets dragged. Camera tilts up to follow. Music: soft pulsing bassline begins, kick drum heartbeat. Sound effects: a cartoon BOING on the leap, a brown blob "WHOA!" yelp.

Shot 2 (1.3s): @Image2 - Hard cut. The BROWN blob SLAMS down onto a giant pink candy cushion and BOUNCES violently upward, body squishing on impact then springing high. The rope snaps taut and CATAPULTS the purple blob upward like a slingshot, who shoots up with eyes spinning. Camera tracks UP fast. Music: drum break drops in fully, bouncy synth bleeps. Sound effects: heavy candy SQUISH on impact, a SPRING-LOAD release sound, two delighted yelps offset.

Shot 3 (1.5s): @Image3 - Hard cut. Close on the industrial fan — the fan suddenly ROARS on at full power and BLASTS the purple blob straight up off the top, body squished and stretched by the wind, the rope yanking the brown blob up after it like a kite tail. Snowflakes streak past the camera as both blobs SHOOT skyward. Music: drums get heavier, synth riser builds. Sound effects: fan WHIR cranking up, roaring wind, panicked clay yelps.

Shot 4 (1.5s): @Image4 - Hard cut. The BROWN devil blob suddenly DIVES upward through a column of glowing embers, devil tail streaming behind, pitchfork held forward. The rope yanks the purple blob up after it, who swings the pitchfork wildly mid-flight. Camera tilts up rapidly. Music: full drum beat with distorted bass, comedic kazoo melody. Sound effects: ember crackle, a devilish "HEH HEH HEH", two staggered yelps.

Shot 5 (1.8s): @Image5 - Hard cut. Wide shot. The two astronaut blobs hold position in space, but the EARTH visibly rotates below them, dramatic camera pull-back revealing more of space, stars streaking past suggesting motion. The brown blob spins slowly on its axis. The purple blob's googly eyes dart left to right, awestruck. Music: drums filter down, soaring synth pad, cinematic whoosh. Sound effects: cosmic shimmer, a tiny "woah", a soft radio static beep.

Shot 6 (1.8s): @Image6 - Hard cut. Both blobs LAUNCH UP from the bottom of the frame and arc over the crest of the rainbow in a high jumping motion, tracing a parabola, the brown blob slightly leading. As they reach the peak, plasticine clouds part dramatically around them. The rope flutters between them. Music: drums punch back in at full power, triumphant synth lead with a hooky melody. Sound effects: a whoosh as they launch, a magical sparkle, two giggles offset.

Shot 7 (1.3s): @Image7 - Hard cut to darkness. Both blobs are FALLING fast in the abyss, eyes wide with terror, mouths open. The giant anglerfish lure pulses below, then the anglerfish suddenly LUNGES upward toward them, jaws filling the lower half of the frame. Camera shakes hard. Music: massive cinematic RISER, drums double-time, ominous bass swell, ALL MUSIC CUTS DEAD on the lunge. Sound effects: water rush, the anglerfish ROARS, two panicked screams.

Shot 8 (1.0s): @Image8 - Extreme close-up macro shot. The red plasticine rope under impossible tension, the purple blob's body just barely visible pulling one way on one side of frame, the brown blob barely visible pulling the other way on the other side. The rope strains, fibers fraying, then SNAPS violently in slow motion, clay fibers exploding outward across the entire frame. Music: complete silence with a high pitched ringing tone. Sound effect: a sharp string pluck rising in pitch, a TWANG, then deep silence and a single low heartbeat thud.

Shot 9 (2.6s): @Image9 - Logo reveal sequence on a pale-blue painted sky. The giant plasticine letter U SLAMS down from the top of the frame and SPLATS onto the ground with a dust puff. A half-beat later the letter P SLAMS down next to it, also splatting, dust puffing. The U BOUNCES upright onto its feet, googly eyes popping open with a comedic boing. The P bounces upright a half-beat later, eyes popping open. The cursive plasticine script "with a stranger" writes itself in below them letter by letter, like an invisible hand. A small wooden sign on the LEFT flips into frame reading "TWO IDIOTS / ONE STRING". A beat later, a yellow warning sign on the RIGHT flips into frame reading "GO UP TOGETHER OR DIE". The U and P do a final tiny offset bounce. Music: bouncy playful outro chord on the splats, quick synth flourish, punchy final stab. Sound effects: two staggered heavy clay SPLATS, two staggered boings, scribbling for the cursive, two staggered wooden sign clacks.

Hard cuts between every single shot, no fades or transitions. Every shot has ONE big specific motion that drives the frame. The blobs are never perfectly synced — there's always a leader and a follower with the rope reacting between them.  
Color palette: warm cream, dusty blue, terracotta brown, plum purple, mustard yellow, rainbow pastels, fire reds, deep abyss blacks.  
Audio overall: punchy modern indie-game-trailer track building from quiet pulse to full beat drop to silent climax to bouncy outro. Foley-heavy clay sounds layered on top. NOT calm, NOT piano-led — energetic, electronic, fun.  
Aspect ratio: 16:9 cinematic.”

replies.author: ilyxxxxa
replies.body:
I generated cinematic stills with the plasticine look in Nanobanana (to explore the style for cut scenes or something like that). Then I gave them to Claude and asked it to check the images and write a good Seedance prompt for a trailer using these scenes.

Wouldn’t call it a storyboard, since there is no story - it’s basically the 2 blobs going through all the different levels and zones available in the game.

Claude wrote the prompt, I gave it to Seedance together with the reference images, and it generated the video you see above. In one shot 🫶

Here is one example of such image that went together with the prompt.

I can also share the full Seedance prompt I used. 

There is no secret recipe. I was just amazed by the output. I did not expect it to handle the animations that well, which is what this whole post is about.

https://preview.redd.it/sptuj58m9dzg1.jpeg?width=688&format=pjpg&auto=webp&s=49f4abc11d39d82c7861c673691a1953e88daecc

comments.author: GrimnirDotDev
comments.body:
With the brown color I read the title at the end as "You Pee with a stranger". Maybe that says more about me than your game, who knows. 

Also call me old fashioned, but I like to see at least some gameplay in my game trailers. Based on the trailer I didn't know what this was about at all. 

And the flow of the trailer was terrible. For the first 3 scenes the main characters "jumped" out of the current scene into the next but then from Hell to Space there's just a hard cut, and then the rest of the transitions are really jarring too.   
And the entire journey seemed random. Ground->Candyland->Frozen HVAC -> Hell -> Space -> A rainbow -> underwater. No progression or order, no ramping up, no setup and payoff. Just randomly generated scenes, randomly put together. The impressive visual quality doesn't make up for the fact that this doesn't tell a story. 

Same problem with the audio - it's all high quality individually but makes no sense in context. Music starts and fades from one scene to another, some scenes have no music. Really jarring.
